notes: British documentary photographer of early-1990s rave culture (not the fashion photographer of the same name); identified via Tate's press release and British Culture Archive. Grew up around football terraces, punk and Northern Soul (Wigan Casino all-nighters). No birth year or further CV found.

items.title: The 90s: Art and Fashion, guest curated by Edward Enninful (Ravers at the Eclipse, Coventry, 1991)

items.text: 90s Rave Scene: documentary photographs of the rave circuit in Nottingham, Coventry and the Midlands, including DiY events at Nottingham's Marcus Garvey Centre, Venus and Kool Kat, The Eclipse in Coventry, and gatherings at Sandbach Services after Shelley's Laserdome, Stoke-on-Trent
Archive represented by British Culture Archive
